title: AnyLogic
description: Documented public simulation modeling software (The AnyLogic Company) for the Invention Evolution Laboratory capability area.
body:
AnyLogic is a documented simulation modeling software from The AnyLogic Company. Multimethod simulation software (agent-based, discrete-event, system dynamics) used to test designs and policies against simulated operating conditions before building.

How it works: It works by integrating a driven first-order process with noise over the step budget and testing whether the tail is stable.

Documented uses of this capability area include corporate innovation programs, patent landscaping for R&D strategy, open-innovation challenges, and systematic inventive-problem-solving training.
